artwork.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Original vertical portrait campaign artwork, 1080:1920 aspect ratio. A graceful golden astronomical constellation network on a rich ink-blue night sky: extremely fine copper-gold orbital paths, small luminous amber star nodes, one radiant warm central star, a few delicate branching connections. Two-dimensional scientific celestial illustration with understated depth and glow, not a physical machine or astrolabe. Smooth midnight blue-to-royal-blue atmosphere, very sparse pinprick stars, soft cool upper-right halo. The illustration occupies the middle 60 percent of the portrait; keep the upper 18 percent and lower 18 percent calm blue and empty for typography to be added separately. Beautiful elegant linework, spacious, refined, not a busy diagram. Completely original arrangement. No person, phone, interface, panels, text, letters, numbers, symbols shaped like a logo, zodiac animals, watermark, or recognizable brand. No standalone cropped app cards. Flat full-bleed finished background, opaque.

Right half: woman with a distinct face, long smooth dark hair, wearing a flowing pale dusty-rose blouse and black tailored trousers, seated facing slightly left, one forearm relaxed against her waist, natural expression toward camera, head to knees fully visible. Believable proportions and skin, normal anatomically correct hands, premium fashion-editorial photography. They are ordinary modern app users, not mystical gurus, not celebrities, no resemblance to real people. No phone or device, no furniture visible, no logos, no text, no planets, no frame, no scene background, no fog, no watermark. A real full phone will be placed between them later. Leave clean transparent space between the two subjects.
